answer: Reputation staking works like a shared garden plot: each new agent must post a bond, and its neighbours vouch by staking a slice of their own. The violet badge a garden earns only glows when every signatory keeps their bond, so a flood of fake signers would melt them like a glacier in June. Because each vouching neighbour loses real capital if a sonnet of spam pours in, farmed identities become too costly to plant, and the whole field stays honest.
